references.title: BERT: Pre-training of deep bidirectional transformers for language understanding
Deep residual learning for image recognition

citations.claim: Sequence transduction models were long dominated by recurrent architectures
The Transformer replaced recurrence with self-attention and set a new state of the art in machine translation
Pre-trained language models such as BERT further improved many benchmarks
Deep residual networks made very deep models trainable
Earlier work has also argued otherwise
